definitions.explanation: Food prepared by simmering in seasoned liquid (typically dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sake). A fundamental Japanese cooking method.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{夕飯|ゆうはん}は{肉|にく}じゃがと{煮物|にもの}です。
examples.english: Today's dinner is nikujaga and simmered vegetables.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}の{煮物|にもの}は{味|あじ}がよく{染|し}みています。
examples.english: My grandmother's simmered dishes are well-seasoned throughout.

examples.japanese: {煮物|にもの}は{時間|じかん}をかけて{作|つく}ると{美味|おい}しいです。
examples.english: Simmered dishes are delicious when you take time to make them.

notes:
{煮物|にもの} is one of the fundamental Japanese cooking methods ({煮|に}る = to simmer/boil).

Common types:
- {肉|にく}じゃが (meat and potatoes)
- {筑前煮|ちくぜんに} (chicken and vegetables)
- {里芋|さといも}の{煮|に}っ{転|ころ}がし (simmered taro)
- かぼちゃの{煮物|にもの} (simmered pumpkin)

Seasoning base:
- {出汁|だし} (dashi stock)
- {醤油|しょうゆ} (soy sauce)
- {味醂|みりん} (mirin)
- {砂糖|さとう} (sugar)
- {酒|さけ} (sake)

Related cooking methods:
- {焼|や}き{物|もの} (grilled)
- {揚|あ}げ{物|もの} (fried)
- {蒸|む}し{物|もの} (steamed)
